title: Customer Experience & Brand Activation
overview: This comprehensive course equips participants with the knowledge and tools necessary to foster a customer-centric culture and develop an effective customer experience (CX) framework within their organization. Participants will learn how to assess customer service effectiveness, devise CX strategies, evaluate CX initiatives, and identify areas for improvement to enhance their CX programs.
audience: This course is ideal for professionals in customer service, marketing, public relations, communications, sales, and operations who are looking to enhance their expertise in customer experience and brand activation.
methodology: The course utilizes a variety of instructional methods, including self-assessments, templates, group exercises, workshops, and relevant video materials. These methods are designed to help participants acquire and apply the competencies needed to design and implement a comprehensive customer experience program.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define the scope of customer service and measure its effectiveness to drive repeat business and organizational growth
Grasp the fundamentals of customer experience management to adapt to evolving consumer expectations and develop an impactful CX program
Craft customer experience strategies and employ empathy to design appealing products/services and memorable customer interactions
Measure CX performance to identify issues, develop recovery strategies, and implement corrective actions
Enhance CX practices to continuously meet service challenges and embed a customer-centric mindset within the organization
